I am an old woman now, 72 years, and my strength is not what it was. This small plot I keep mixed with different crops as we have always done here in Kigoma — it feeds the household, we do not sell much. I have no money for the shop fertilizer, and the rains here come once, so I rely on what God gives. My children help me with the hoe work, and sometimes I ask a neighbor for a few days when the weeds are heavy.
